Confirmed two bugs from fresh-game replays. Bug B (dash through wall): seed 1, [right, dash-down] puts the player at (2,3) with Dash 5, even though (2,2) is a wall. Not explored further: other mechanics (gates, levers, enemies, pause/dialog buttons, win path). Minimal tokens are verified by reasoning, not by removal replays.

(2) Spikes with score below 500 wrap the score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0: [right, dash-right, down, down, left] takes score 100 to 65136 and costs a life. Not yet probed: level complete and time bonus, timer expiry, heart cap, score cap at 999,999, enemy swap collision, locked door dash, lever gates. Budget is nearly spent, so these were left untested.

reports.title: Restart level from pause menu leaves game paused
reports.observed: After pause then clicking btn-restart, mode is paused and the game does not run; the pause menu stays in effect.
reports.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode playing).

reports.title: Spikes with score below 500 wrap score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
reports.observed: Score 100 becomes 65136 after touching spikes (score goes negative and wraps); lives drop by 1.
reports.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0, never going below zero (expected score 0).
